H3_Cantor_Robust.name: H3-Cantor-Robust
H3_Cantor_Robust.description: Unified 3D homothetic b=3.0, g_min=27 nm Cantor rotary-axial switch with Vernier lobe staggering, homothetic micro-bridges, and stepped landing pads.

Ctrl_KnifeEdge_g27.name: Ctrl-KnifeEdge-g27
Ctrl_KnifeEdge_g27.description: 19-track uniform W=90 nm, w=36 nm, g_r=27 nm single-stage point optimizer matching H3-Cantor-Robust in A_tooth, open-slot budget, stator metal budget, and g_min.

Ctrl_Uni_7Trk.name: Ctrl-Uni-7Trk
Ctrl_Uni_7Trk.description: Uniform 7-track single-stage periodic grating at z_stage = -120 nm, matched A_tooth.

Ctrl_Mono_3Stage.name: Ctrl-Mono-3Stage
Ctrl_Mono_3Stage.description: Monotonic radial ordering (3,3,3,3,2,2,1) of exact Cantor track multiset, synchronized phase.

Ctrl_Shuf_OutPhase.name: Ctrl-Shuf-OutPhase
Ctrl_Shuf_OutPhase.description: Cross-dimensionally decoupled control: Cantor radial slots paired out-of-phase (m_z = 4 - m_r).

H3_Cantor_Sym_2x2x2.name: H3-Cantor-Sym-2x2x2
H3_Cantor_Sym_2x2x2.description: Unified 3D homothetic b=3.0, g_min=27 nm Cantor rotary-axial switch with centered slot-symmetric phase (Delta_phi = 0 deg), homothetic micro-bridges, stepped landing pads, and refined 2x2x2 lobe BEM discretization.
